news.title: 留乡艺术家游戏创业指南：如何在未获得巨大成功的情况下经营工作室
news.summary: 如果我无法生存，或者如果创作的乐趣被剥夺，那么追求这些目标又有什么意义呢？

content.v: https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/headpic/2026/11/head-7041dX-banner.jpg
本文来自 GDC 官方 Youtube 频道的 《GDC 2023》合集 ，原内容形式为视频演讲。目前，indienova 已取得 GDC Youtube 频道的视频转文稿译制授权，未来将持续进行 GDC 历年精华演讲的编译整理工作，以图文形式分享。
应版权方要求，我们将在每篇文章的文首嵌入原 Youtube 视频。考虑到可能存在的播放问题，我们将继续与 GDC 官方沟通，力图为国内读者带来更便利的呈现形式和更舒适的阅读/观看体验。
我是 Yngvill Hopen，一名视觉艺术家。我的艺术生涯始于传统艺术领域，但游戏的魅力让我最终转向了游戏行业。目前，我在挪威西部常年潮湿的城市卑尔根经营着一家名为 Henchman & Goon 的小型工作室。尽管我的身份依然是艺术家——就在几年前，我还获得了概念艺术的学位，但经营工作室让我体验到了不同的工作方式，我需要在团队中协作，这正是我非常享受的部分。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/11/pic-16635V5.png

大约 11 年前，我和一群刚从大学毕业的朋友共同创办了 Henchman & Goon。截至目前，我们一共发布了三款游戏：第一款是《Flem》，一款 PC 端的小型 2D 平台游戏；第二款是《Pode》，这是我们迄今为止发布的规模最大、最具野心的作品，支持 PC 和主机平台；第三款是《Pode Kids》，这是我们去年夏天在 Google Play 上推出的儿童活动应用。我们还有三款游戏正处于不同的开发阶段，不过本次演讲中，我想着重聊一聊《Pode》。

我们从 2015 年开始开发《Pode》，那时距离创立 Henchman & Goon 过去了大约三年。整个开发过程持续了三年，期间大部分时间由四人核心团队负责，时不时会短期增加一两名成员。直到开发最后六个月，开发团队幸运地扩大到了七人，并有音效和音乐制作人员加入。2018 年 6 月，《Pode》在 Switch 平台正式发布，但市场表现却不尽如人意。坦白说，那个夏天对我们所有人来说都并不愉快。然而，事情最终迎来了转机，关于这一点，我稍后会详细展开。
我想先简单介绍一下我的成长背景。我成长于一个艺术氛围浓厚的家庭，家人多为艺术家、音乐家、演员和创意工作者。从记事起，我就一直在进行艺术创作，在艺术领域取得成功的观念也深深扎根于我的生活。我很早就下定决心要以艺术为生。而一旦确立了这个目标，你就会开始思考，成为一名成功或失败的艺术家究竟意味着什么。同时，你也会在作品和艺术风格上产生好胜心，甚至对成功艺术家的形象变得有些执着。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/11/pic-26663TM.png

我自然也不例外，也曾经历过那种年轻气盛、自命不凡的艺术家阶段。那时，我将自己的身份认同与我心中艺术家的形象紧密联系在一起。老实说，年轻时我们常常被一些陈词滥调影响，从而形成这些观念。其中一个典型观念是：你必须为艺术受苦，将全部自我投入到艺术中，绝不能让平庸的生活妨碍艺术的伟大。因此，当有人建议我除了艺术创作外，或许还需要考虑一些其他事情，比如找一份有薪水的工作时，我有时会有些抵触。难道除了从灵魂深处创作艺术，我还需要做其他事情吗？

我妈妈对我的自负从来没什么耐心，她只是告诉我：“艺术家也要吃饭。”从字面上看，这句话很简单——每个人都需要吃饭。但在当时的语境下，它还意味着我和其他人并没有什么不同，我们都需要为了生活而做一些必要的事情。这既是生理需求，也是作为社会成员的责任。我们不能简单决定成为某类人，并宣称自己拥有特权，从而免于承担其他所有责任。妈妈的这句话在我需要时让我清醒过来，我带着这句话去面对之后的每一件事，包括创办 Henchman & Goon，这在后来的故事中变得尤为重要。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/11/pic-3_cn6675FB.jpg

让我们回到创办 Henchman & Goon 的故事。正如我之前提到的，工作室成立时，我们大多数人刚从大学毕业。虽然其中一些人已经做了一段时间自由职业，对小企业的经营略知一二，但大多数时候，我们对这段冒险真正意味着什么几乎一无所知。我们之所以想要创办自己的工作室，有很充分的理由：我们渴望创作自由，每个人都有自己想实现的创意；我们希望继续和朋友们一起工作，并为自己建立一番事业；然而最重要的是，我们想做游戏，而当时本地没有这样的工作机会，甚至几乎没有游戏工作室。因此，如果我们想留在家乡，同时又不放弃梦想，创办自己的工作室基本上是唯一选择。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/11/pic-4_cn6701rq.jpg

作为一群经验尚浅的游戏开发者，我们该如何迈出第一步？制定计划似乎是个不错的开始，而这个计划的首要任务就是存活。无论是艺术创作还是游戏开发，都需要时间，因此，为了实现目标，我们必须确保在游戏开发过程中能够维持生计。在工作室成立后的三年里，我们主要依靠合同项目和兼职来维持运作。所谓合同项目，指的是为本地餐厅设计菜单、制作书籍封面等工作。同时，我们也在空闲时间开发小型游戏。我们并不介意这样的状态，因为我们清楚自己的计划。我们正一步步向目标迈进——最终摆脱合同项目，全身心投入到工作室的游戏开发中。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/11/pic-5_cn6716vH.jpg
大约在工作室成立三年后，我们终于发布了《Flem》。原本，我们预期这款游戏能带来一定收益。考虑到有限的预算，我们认为只要达到很少的销量，就能收回成本并赚取一些额外收入。当然，事情并没有按预期发展，但也不至于让我们大失所望。我们完成了游戏并将其推向市场，过程本身让我们感到欣慰。这个过程更像是一次实验——我们尝试打造属于自己的游戏，并从过程中学习。带着积累的经验，我们继续向前。

然而，创业的蜜月期已结束，我们不得不开始认真思考工作室的未来方向。大家逐渐有些厌倦必须依靠兼职来维持生计的生活。虽然我们尝试了其他项目，但都未能成功。项目资金难以筹得，团队在工作重心上的分歧也日益加剧。通过合同项目，我们已经积累了一批稳定的客户，同时一些合伙人发现，相较于游戏开发，他们对软件开发更感兴趣。这些年来，我们还吸引了更大、更具影响力的客户，他们为离岸业务提供了一些有趣的解决方案，这对我们来说利润可观。因此，在这个节点上，我们意识到，与其将团队朝着不同方向拉扯，不如将工作室拆分成两个独立团队。我们顺利地将工作室分为两个团队，过程中没有出现戏剧性冲突，团队关系仍旧和睦。我们依然共用同一间办公室，甚至在需要时共享人员和项目。留下来的团队专注于开发《Pode》，同时继续承接合同项目和兼职，朝着最终目标前行。

自从创办 Henchman & Goon 以来，我们一直在为各个项目寻求外部资金。尽管公司已成立四年，但我们仍在做那些本以为不会再涉足的事情——合同项目、兼职，以及各种与真正做游戏无关的工作。我们依然艰难求生，尚未实现盈利，但这并不意味着一无所获。我们积累了宝贵的财富：我们建立了一支彼此关心、合作愉快的团队，证明了自己有能力完成并成功发布项目。此外，我们投入大量时间，建立了一个庞大的社区，他们支持并相信着我们。正是这些努力，最终为我们赢得了项目资金，使我们得以完成《Pode》。尽管我们仍然需要承担一些外部工作，偶尔为资金奔波，但至少有三年时间，可以将主要精力投入到自己的项目中。这是充满了喜悦、泪水、压力和兴奋的三年。而最终将花费多年心血的作品发布出去时，那种感觉是无法用语言表达的。

因此，当结果不尽如人意时，那种打击绝对是令人心碎的。作为开发者，我们经常被告知，一款游戏必须卖出超过一万、两万份，甚至更多，才能被视为成功。而所谓的成功，当然是指收回成本并实现盈利。与其他项目相比，我们在这个项目上投入了更多的时间、资源和热爱，因此，失败带来的冲击也远非其他项目可比。我们曾告诉自己，这个项目将是推动我们迈向成功的关键一步，只要坚持到发布的那一天，一切都会变得容易。并且，这个项目还牵涉到员工、投资者，以及那些与我们签订了版税协议的合作伙伴，他们都依赖于我们，因此失败也会让这些人失望。那种感觉很像是经历了一场失去，你倾尽所有的热爱与能量打造美丽的事物，却在来到世界的瞬间就夭折了。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/11/pic-6_cn6745oS.jpg
于是，你开始怀疑自己，思考是否还有坚持下去的意义。我们真的应该为了我们的艺术承受如此多的痛苦吗？然而，我们已经坚持了六年，尽管我们在思考未来是否还有希望，但最终还是回到了熟悉的事情上。我们重新接下合同项目，启动了一个新项目，同时也接了一些兼职，继续艰难求生。
就在我们艰难求生的时候，奇怪的事情发生了。一款游戏发布后，其销量通常会在最初几周或几个月内达到高峰，随后便会大幅下降。因此，当游戏在发行初期销量不佳时，你会预期后续销量也会急转直下，回本更是成了遥不可及的梦想。然而，《Pode》的销量几乎没有出现任何下降。随着时间的推移，我们意识到，如果这种趋势能够持续下去，我们或许有机会实现回本的目标。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/11/pic-7_cn6772yJ.jpg

现在，我们必须重新振作，寻找前进方向。不过，我们的视角也稍微发生了转变，不再仅从计划维度出发，而是开始从优先级角度权衡选择。多年来，我们一直在用同样的方式运作，却收效甚微——尽管这让我们坚持到了现在。但问题是，我们是否愿意花费全部时间去追逐某种理想中的成功，却一次次经历失望的打击？于是，我们开始反思，重新审视自己拥有的一切：团队中彼此关心的伙伴，相信并支持我们的社区，我们的公司，我们在乎的项目，以及那份共同做游戏的热情。
我们制定了一份全新的优先级清单，虽然听起来清晰直接，但实际上，这一转变并非一蹴而就，而是经过循序渐进的视角调整才逐渐明确。首先，我们必须确保生存，如果连基本需求都得不到满足，那么创造更是无从谈起。同样重要的是，我们希望在创作美丽艺术和有趣游戏的同时，享受工作和生活的每一天。此外，我们不想再追逐某种虚无缥缈的未来目标。接下来，让我详细解释这份清单对我们的意义。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/11/pic-8_cn6811oy.jpg

存活意味着彼此关爱、相互扶持。这意味着团队中的每个人都在努力创造让大家都能感到安全和幸福的环境。要感到安全和幸福，人们需要体面的薪资、充足的食物和安稳的住所等基本条件；需要与家人和朋友共度时光，也需要属于自己的独处时光；需要被倾听，感受到自己的价值。这意味着，当开发工作过于紧张时，我们需要放慢节奏；我们需要允许人们有不那么高效的时候，因为每个人都会经历低谷或缺乏灵感的时刻，我们需要空间去过渡与重新振作，而不是因过度工作而走向崩溃；这同样意味着我们要打造能够激发灵感的环境，让每个人都能全情投入、发挥所长。换句话说，这意味着我们优先考虑人的需求，而项目则排在其次。

你们可能都听过这样一句话：生活是在你忙于制定计划时悄然发生的。这句话很好地诠释了清单中的这一点。我们最初踏入游戏开发领域，是因为我们都是充满创意的人，喜欢创造新事物。在游戏开发变成工作之前，这也是我们闲暇时的乐趣。然而，如果工作变成了仅是按部就班地完成任务、制作产品，而职业生涯中唯一的高光时刻只是完成项目的那一天，那么这一切又有什么意义呢？但如果你热爱自己的作品，并享受创作的过程，那么回顾过去时，收获的将是快乐与成就感。另一方面，如果你能与自己的作品建立起深厚的联结，那么游戏发布后的所有工作也会变得更加轻松，无论是移植到新平台、运营社群，还是市场营销和公关，你能在做这些事情的过程中获得乐趣。
最后，失望往往源于现实未能达到预期。如果你能调整好预期，就不会那么容易感到失望。这并不是说你不该全力以赴推出作品，也不是要你对一切持悲观态度，而是说，你应该有所准备：如果游戏发布后的收益无法解决所有问题，你该如何继续前行？如果一切结果都不如预期，你又该如何生存下去？如何在失望中，依然让团队和你保持快乐和有安全感？正当我们将注意力放在存活、创作艺术并享受生活的时候，《Pode》的销售却开始回暖。
2021 年，《Pode》迎来了自发布以来销量最好的一个夏天。到了 2022 年，情况更上一层楼，当我们夏季休假归来时，发现销售额已让我们成功回本，这比我们预期的更早。作为参考，过去几年《Pode》每年销量大约下降 20%，而 2022 年相比 2021 年反倒增长了 26.5%。看起来，这一增长趋势在 2023 年仍在延续。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/11/pic-96838zP.png
现在我们有些困惑了，这似乎不是事情发展的正常轨迹。那么，销量为什么会持续增长呢？当然，为了提升销量，我们做了许多努力：不断推出新平台版本、举办社区活动、参加各类大会、尽可能地提供折扣，并保持线上社区的活跃度。然而，我们并未采取任何突破性举措，基本上只是稳定维护产品。因此，我们试图弄清楚这一切究竟是如何发生的。如果能总结出一套可复制的成功模式，那将对我们大有裨益。
我们得出的结论是，我们的确做出了一款优秀的游戏。这样说或许听起来有点傻气，甚至有点自夸，但我保证这才是关键所在。《Pode》拥有不错的 Metacritic 评分、正面的游戏评价、良好的玩家反馈，还拥有非常可爱的玩家社区。问题在于，如果仅以销量和盈利来衡量成功，那么以上这些价值都很容易被忽视。人们很容易放弃维护那些看似已经失败的项目，而许多优秀的游戏也正是因此被埋没。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/11/pic-106850Ej.png

我们都身处以将人们逼至极限而闻名的游戏行业。我们常常过于关注里程碑、发布日期和销量，却忘了当初选择进入这个行业的初衷。我们之所以能够如此鞭策自己，是因为我们对自己所做的事情充满热情。我们渴望继续做下去，渴望做得更好，渴望交出作品，渴望作品能被看见，渴望我们的艺术能被认可。我们也早已做好了为之吃苦的准备。让我们回到我妈妈的那句“艺术家也要吃饭”，以及这句话对我的意义。它让我能够停下来思考：如果我无法生存，或者如果创作的乐趣被剥夺，那么追求这些目标又有什么意义呢？
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/picture/2026/11/pic-11_cn6865cW.jpg
以下这些理念是我们在经营工作室时努力践行的，也希望能为大家带来一些新的思考和收获：
感谢大家。
Q1：在积累了这些经验后，Henchman & Goon 工作室目前在做些什么？未来有哪些计划？
A1： 我们目前正在推进多个项目，正努力开发其中一个主要项目，并为其争取资金支持。这个项目花费的时间比我们预期的要长，因为我们每一步都非常谨慎，避免给团队施加过多压力，尽可能保持从容的节奏。如果进度过快或遇到较大挑战，我们会暂停下来，仔细思考下一步该怎么做。
Q2：现在你知道了《Pode》的销售曲线，如果能回到游戏发布之前，你会做出哪些不同的决定？

A2： 当时我们还是一个非常稚嫩的工作室，制作《Pode》是我们第一次开发如此大规模的项目，而且我们决定自发行，因此所有事情都由我们自己负责。但由于当时对游戏发行流程并不完全了解，难免会犯一些错误。回过头看，如果有机会重新选择，我们可能会考虑找一家发行商，哪怕对方不提供资金支持，至少也能帮助我们更专业地进行游戏发布，并提升知名度。毕竟，如果游戏发布时就能有更好的市场表现，即使销售曲线保持不变，整体成绩也会比现在的更理想。
Q3：你们是如何建立游戏社区的？

A3： 参与游戏社区活动对我们一直非常重要，我们一直在努力结识挪威游戏社区的每一个人，并积极参加各类展会。作为开发者，在发布作品并取得一定成就后，很容易忽视那些看起来技能较低或尚未取得类似成就的人。但对我们来说，坚持不忽视任何人是至关重要的，因为你永远不知道智慧会从何而来。因此，我们欢迎每一位有兴趣参与的人，并尽可能提供帮助，无论是粉丝、玩家、学生，还是其他任何人。我们希望每个人都能参与到这段旅程中来。
Q4：你们如何在保持健康工作环境的同时，平衡摆脱合同项目的需求，尤其是在追求工作成就感的情况下？
A4： 随着承接的合同项目越来越多，我们也逐渐参与到更加有趣的合作中。目前，我们正和其他游戏工作室合作开发一些很酷的项目，还和交响乐团合作，为他们的音乐会打造视觉效果。这些合作让我们的工作更加充满乐趣。因此，我认为我们的目标已经发生了变化，现在我们的目标不再是摆脱合同项目，而是找到那些最酷、最有趣的合同项目，与优秀的团队合作，共同打造令人惊叹的作品。
Q5：你们是如何与发行商建立联系，并成功获得他们的发行支持的？
A5： 我们会通过多种渠道与发行商建立联系，比如发送邮件，或是在像 GDC 这样的活动中主动交流。我们尽量让自己被看见，不害羞，也不害怕被拒绝。很多人因为害怕收到负面反馈而迟迟不敢行动，但这种心理障碍才是最需要克服的。
Q6：《Pode》在发布时采用了怎样的付费广告策略？你们如今是否仍在推广这款游戏？
A6： 大约在发布前六个月左右，一位投资者加入了我们，并提供了营销预算，使我们能够聘请公关公司协助推广。他们帮助我们向媒体推广，发布新闻稿等。这对我们来说很有帮助，因为如果没有这样的专业支持，我们肯定无法如此有效地触及媒体资源。
至于现在，我们依然在持续推广《Pode》。正如我之前提到的，我们采取了多种营销方式，虽然不一定是高预算的广告投放，但我们会通过折扣促销、活动推广，尽可能扩展游戏的发布平台，并尽量保持社交媒体的活跃度，以确保与玩家保持紧密联系。偶尔我们也会投放一些低预算的付费广告，虽然规模不大，但足以保持游戏销量逐渐自然增长。
Q7：相比之下，丹麦和瑞典的游戏产业似乎一直比挪威更发达。为什么会出现这种差异？如今是否有所改变？
A7：这种差异如今依然存在，挪威的游戏产业规模非常小。我不确定是否能给出确切的答案，但毫无疑问，瑞典和丹麦政府在推动本国游戏产业发展上做了大量工作。当然，近年来挪威也发生了许多有趣的变化，政府对游戏产业的关注度逐渐提升，我们已经能明显看到这些努力正在产生积极影响——挪威的游戏产业确实在增长，越来越多有趣的作品开始涌现。我希望这种差距能够逐渐缩小，但要追赶上瑞典那样的产业规模，仍然会很困难。

news.title: PS5 QSSR 更新公布，适用于 Marvel 蜘蛛侠 2、Arc Raiders 等游戏
news.summary: Sony has confirmed Marvel's Spider-Man 2, Arc Raiders, and four more games are receiving QSSR support on base

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2025/01/30/pc-first-mins-br-1738277933414.jpg
Sony has confirmed Marvel's Spider-Man 2 , Arc Raiders , and four more games are receiving QSSR support on base PS5s.

The list of six newcomers joining the small-but-growing group of supported games was unveiled in a PlayStation.Blog post . In addition to confirmation that incoming updates will add QSSR (Quick Spectral Super Resolution), the post included testimonials from each of the studios' developers, who shared how the tech will impact visuals.

When Sony pulled back the curtain on QSSR in October, it came with confirmation that it had already been implemented in Marvel's Wolverine and Ghost of Yōtei. Now, we know that Insomniac's Marvel's Spider-Man 2, Remedy Entertainment's Control Resonant , Embark Studios' Arc Raiders and The Finals , Hello Games' No Man's Sky , and Expression Games' Hell Let Loose: Vietnam will soon take advantage of the AI upscaling tech.
In the case of Marvel's Spider-Man 2, QSSR is available as part of a new update that's out now.

"Having seen great results integrating QSSR in Marvel’s Wolverine, our team decided to bring it to Marvel’s Spider-Man 2 as well, in an update that’s live now!" Insomniac head of technology Mike Fitzgerald said. "We’re excited for players to swing back into our 2023 title and see QSSR’s exciting image stability and sharpness benefits in both Fidelity and Performance modes."

Remedy said QSSR will bring noticeable improvements in image stability and fine detail when it launches in a new update in December. Hello Games founder Sean Murray, meanwhile, promised that players can look forward to No Man's Sky looking "sharper, cleaner, and more beautiful" at the "best possible framerate" in the next few weeks. When exactly The Finals, Arc Raiders, and Hell Let Loose: Vietnam will receive their updates has yet to be announced.

"With the new QSSR coming soon to ARC Raiders and The Finals, we can deliver increased sharpness, better environmental clarity, and overall visual improvements to even more PlayStation players," Embark said. "We are very happy to see Sony’s continued investment in PlayStation technology translate into meaningful improvements for all players, bringing more immersive experiences across the PlayStation ecosystem."

Sony then teased that developers interested in using QSSR are "just getting started." More PS5 games are set to receive similar updates in the coming months, though which titles will join the list remains to be seen.

news.title: 芭比倒带评论

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/13/untitled-november-13-2026-at-15-23-38-1794605074548.png

Barbie Rewind 的感觉就像是向您的孩子展示传家宝的摇马，然后看着他们戳它并询问是否可以玩 Roblox。它是怀旧与室内装饰模拟游戏的奇怪结合，是 17 个复古芭比娃娃游戏的所在地，也是一个可以摆放适合芭比娃娃的家具的梦幻屋。现在，距离我上次用芭比娃娃与大兵打砸已经过去三十多年了。乔并发出接吻的声音，所以我请了两位游戏专家科拉（9）和帕洛玛（5）来协助这次审查。可悲的是，与她的外表不同，时间对芭比的游戏遗产并不友善。

“这没有道理。为什么她有潜水面罩却没有厕所？”当女孩们陷入《芭比之倒带》中她们真正关心的唯一一点：装饰时，科拉提出了一个至关重要的问题。这可能是作为芭比游戏合集来推销的，从 1991 年的 NES 芭比到 2007 年的《芭比岛公主》，但它新创建的 Dreamhouse 模式是这里的大赢家。超过250件家具，其中一些家具是通过玩复古芭比游戏来解锁的。大B和肯、克里斯蒂等其他角色会给你任务，但他们只是为了装饰房子，所以这有点像当你已经从楼梯上摔下来时有人说“小心”。
芭比娃娃游戏本身就有我所说的礼貌小提琴。在请专家顾问之前，我玩过所有这些游戏，而《Rewind》则以平台跳跃和“接住掉落的椰子”等迷你游戏为主。这些游戏并没有像《猴岛》那样重新启动；它们看起来完全按原样呈现，但具有与其各种控制台相关的框架，以帮助解决任何宽高比问题。

作为博物馆藏品，它非常棒，但向 2010 年之后出生的人展示它，它们基本上看起来就像洞穴壁画。 “那是芭比娃娃吗？”科拉眯着眼睛看着《芭比宠物救援》，难以置信地问道。帕洛玛拿起控制器玩其中一个迷你游戏，一种用两只爪子玩乒乓球的游戏，这显然对宠物护理至关重要，然后看着毛线球笨拙地从屏幕上弹开。她知道控制器，她玩乐高蝙蝠侠，但这个迷你游戏毫无意义。球速度很慢，角度也有偏差，帕洛玛愤怒地看着我，好像我个人冒犯了她一样。

控制始终是一个问题，在游戏之间进行切换意味着要查找按钮布局以找到他们想要尝试的所有内容。一个明智的补充是可以选择调整某些游戏中的总体健康状况等内容，从而减轻整体压力。女孩们喜欢其中很多的概念——兽医职责、赛马，尤其是时尚装扮娃娃——但这些孩子是在你知道你在游戏封面上看到的与实际看起来相差数光年之后很久才出生的。仅凭怀旧之情，我就可以忍受像素化的弹跳和生硬的对话，但科拉和帕洛玛正在玩霍格沃茨的遗产;他们有 iPad 游戏，他们的眼睛不知道盯着行驶中的车辆后座的 Gameboy Color 带来的创伤。

news.title: 其中一些 GTA 6 剪辑看起来非常好，我不在乎它是否以 30 fps 运行
news.summary: Earlier this week, Rockstar confirmed that GTA 6 would be running at 30fps on all of the consoles, including t

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/29/gta-6-jason-and-lucia-drive-by-1793234705694.jpg
This is an opinion piece by Jackie Thomas, IGN's Senior Tech Editor who has been writing about PC hardware for more than a decade.

Earlier this week, Rockstar confirmed that GTA 6 would be running at 30fps on all of the consoles , including the PS5 Pro. And while I wasn't surprised, I've been watching some of the clips that have been trickling out this week, and I can't say I'm not excited to play it, even at 30fps.

The one that really got my attention is this one from Instagram account onlyindade. It's a simple clip of some cars slowly driving down the road, but it looks downright incredible. I've been staring at high-end graphics for 20 years, and even I had to do a double take to make sure it wasn't just real-life footage. The footage is highly compressed and it's hard to make out some of the details, but even with compression artifacts, you can tell GTA 6 is going to be an absolutely stunning game.

Pausing the video and looking at the road, the texture quality is incredible. You can make out individual bumps in the asphalt, along with little pieces of debris on the side of the road. Looking at the cars themselves, the reflections in the cars' paint are beautiful and make it look like an actual material. The shadows, too, are nice and soft and behave similarly to how you'd expect the actual shadows of the cars to behave, leaning away from where the sun is.

These clips from onlyindade don't specify which platform they were captured on, but I'd put my money on the PS5 Pro . In its blog earlier this week , Rockstar said the PS5 Pro would have PSSR upscaling and ray traced shadows that are exclusive to that console. Looking at the shadows cast by the cars in that clip, along with the lack of aliasing on the distant buildings – which admittedly might be drowned out by compression blurriness – it definitely looks like PSSR helped quite a bit.

Onlyindade shared another clip , this time with the camera inside of a car and looking out the window as it drives down the street. Just like in the first clip, the textures on the car door are pristine, and just straight-up look real. Later on in the clip, when whoever's behind the camera is walking on the sidewalk, the camera looks at a blue and pink car that looks like it came straight out of the '50s.

In that part of the scene, it's not the car that impresses me, but rather the shadows cast from the palm tree above it. Again, this clip is super compressed, but you can make out individual leaves in the shadows. There's also a character standing next to the car on his phone, and the shadows there look phenomenal and even move flawlessly as he does.

When looking at these clips, it's important to keep in mind that both the PS5 and the Xbox Series X are running on graphics architectures that are going on 7 years old at this point. It doesn't help that those graphics chips are paired with CPUs that are just as old. Even with that aging hardware, it sure seems like Rockstar was able to craft something that looks better than any other game on the market right now.

Maybe it was just my internet connection, but all of the clips shared by that Dade County Instagram account are extremely compressed, and so it's very possible that some red flags were grayed out. In a huge open world like this with long draw distances, the detail on distant objects is usually the first thing to fall, especially as the game runs out of VRAM budget.

In that first clip, it looks like the edges of distant objects are going to be crisp, but the compression artifacts make those kinds of details seem wobbly no matter how good they look. There's a decent chance that when I boot this game up on my PS5 Pro at launch, I'm going to be assaulted by jagged edges on distant streetlights and buildings – and that is one of my pet peeves. But it doesn't look like that's the case. I just hope I haven't been fooled by online compression.

More than anything, these clips confirm that 60fps was probably out of the question for the current-generation consoles. With this level of fidelity, I'm just surprised it's running at all. But the one thought that keeps bouncing around in my head is, "Just how good will this look when I can run it on an RTX 5090 and a 9800X3D ?" Now I just have to sit and wait for Rockstar to port the game. Hopefully the rumors about the PC port coming out next year are true.

news.title: 《万智牌》《星际迷航》指挥官预告片排名：为什么我们是博格占据榜首
news.summary: We ranked all four Magic: The Gathering Star Trek Commander precons—from Picard’s Federation Fleet to We Are t

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/07/17/star-trek-commander-deck-deal-amazon-ign-1784274048211.png
Magic: The Gathering’s Star Trek set is finally here, closing out a particularly packed release schedule for Wizards of the Coast’s long-running TCG.

Star Trek is the seventh set of the year, and it brings with it another four Commander decks to take this year’s total to 17. Still, as we all know, not all decks are created equal - so which one comes out on top?
The Klingons or the Borg? Picard or Spock? Here’s our ranking.
Before We Begin

If you’re picking up all four decks because you’re a Trekkie, or you just love new precons, Amazon has cut the price of the bundle again to just $224.97 , basically offsetting the “Universes Beyond” tax.
That’s not the Collector Editions, though: Those are well over $100 each. They include the same cards, but all in foil.
Ranking Magic’s Star Trek Decks
Federation Fleet
Color Identity: Jeskai (blue, red, white)
Reprints of note: Alhammarret’s Archive
Magic loves to put heroic precons in Jeskai colors, and Federation Fleet is no exception - although it does come last in our ranking.

Its primary Commander, Jean-Luc Picard, Luminary, is a four-cost 2/4 that draws you cards as you play historic permanents, which then triggers the Seek Out mechanic. This lets you charge up a Spacecraft and add a counter to another target creature.
It’s not that it’s not a fun, cohesive deck, but it’s definitely just not as interesting on a mechanical level as the others in this set.
Klingon Fury
Color Identity: Mardu (white, black, red)
Reprints of note: Sword of Light, Shadow and World at War
Worf, Defiant Commander is in charge of the Klingon Fury deck, which makes use of the Battlefront mechanic to encourage players to play aggressively.

Worf creates Klingon Warrior tokens when it hits the battlefield, and the more opponents you attack on your turn, the more cards you exile from the top of your library, which you can play until the end of your next turn.
It’s not quite cheating big creatures into play, but it should mean you’re well-stocked with options as long as you keep Worf around.
Landing Party
Color Identity: Bant (green, white, blue)
Reprints of note: Ancient Greenwarden, Scute Swarm, Exploration, Heroic Intervention
Commander Spock is the logical choice for a Commander in Bant colors, and Wizards of the Coast has made it so here (sorry).

Landing Party’s Strange New Worlds mechanic helps play cards more quickly if you’ve got more differently named lands in the set. Given there are 40 in the deck, that should be easily done, but this deck also gives you a big bundle of non-basic lands in Bant colors if you need them.

Captain Kirk, Boldly Going, is another Commander option. William Shatner himself is a 3/4 with vigilance who powers up your Spacecraft cards. The card can also grab you land cards or the Enterprise from your library or graveyard.
We Are The Borg
Color Identity: Esper (white, blue, black)
Reprints of note: Toxic Deluge, Unwinding Clock, Morphic Pool

Our top pick for the Commander precons in the Star Trek set is We Are The Borg . Standing somewhere between artifact synergies and a “what’s yours is mine” deck, The Borg Queen pumps artifact creatures and also assimilates cards to your side of the battlefield.

Unwinding Clock is a very welcome reprint here since it fits nicely into just about any other artifact strategy, and Locutus of Borg can help you pull even more Borg to the table. It’s a deck that’s likely to get out of hand pretty quickly, and for that reason, it’s our top pick.

For more on Magic: The Gathering, check out some of our favorite Commander decks of all time , as well as the latest on reprints of the sought-after Universes Beyond: Warhammer 40K decks , and the most valuable cards to look out for in the new Star Trek Universes Beyond set .

news.title: “实体”GTA 6 副本可能容易受到一个非常愚蠢但严重的骗局的影响
news.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 ditched traditional discs for its "physical" launch, with Rockstar's game being sold as a d

content.v: Grand Theft Auto 6 ditched traditional discs for its "physical" launch, with Rockstar's game being sold as a digital code-in-box at retailers beginning this week. However, it appears a packaging choice may have accidentally left the game vulnerable to thieves--assuming they have a flashlight.

As shared on the forum ResetEra , users who received a physical version of Grand Theft Auto 6, at least in PEGI regions, report that the game's download code is printed directly on the inside of the cover rather than on a card or separate insert. When a flashlight is focused on the cover from the outside of the closed game case, the download code is visible in reverse.
In other words, there's a serious risk people could go into a store, do this trick, redeem the code, and leave the poor soul who actually buys the game off the shelf without GTA 6.

At this time, the trick does not seem to work on North American copies of GTA 6, as the code is intentionally obscured. Why Rockstar would not use this strategy on all regions is unclear. We've reached out to Rockstar for an explanation and will update this post if and when we receive a response.

If you happen to get your GTA 6 code stolen after paying $80 , you can at least sleep soundly knowing that the thief can't play the game yet. Code-in-box copies, as well as digital preorders, all unlock for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on November 19.

news.title: EA 以 550 亿美元私有化后，GTA 6 所有者 Take-Two 无意出售自己
news.summary: Recently, the gaming giant Electronic Arts was taken private in a $55 billion sale to an investor consortium l

content.v: Recently, the gaming giant Electronic Arts was taken private in a $55 billion sale to an investor consortium led by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund. Could GTA 6 owner Take-Two be the next big company that gets acquired? Don't bet on it, CEO Strauss Zelnick says.
Speaking to David Rubenstein , Zelnick said Take-Two's business results have proven that it "can do very well as an independent company."
He said Take-Two's business is already "at scale" and healthy enough financially with a "terrific balance sheet," as he put it.
"We are not in a place where we need to be part of a bigger organization to be competitive. And in the entertainment business, scale matters," he said.

Zelnick said companies that do less than a billion in annual revenue might have issues with developing, marketing, and distributing games at scale. Not only that, but companies that don't generate a lot of money might not be able to survive the realities of the creative business, in which sometimes your product flops.

"But once you're over a billion dollars in annual revenue, and we're way beyond that point. Our guidance is $8 billion to $8.2 billion this fiscal year, additional scale doesn't seem to help you succeed."

In early 2008, Electronic Arts privately pursued a buyout of Take-Two, but after the GTA and BioShock company rejected it, EA went public in an attempt to get a deal done. Later that year, EA abandoned its plans to try to buy Take-Two after the GTA company said it was worth more and EA refused to increase its bid.
In 2019, it was rumored that Sony was attempting to buy Take-Two, but that was ultimately deemed to be unconfirmed market chatter and not a formal bid .

Take-Two has a market cap of more than $42 billion, and that is expected to grow in the year ahead , so it would seemingly take a lot of money to convince Take-Two to sell. Going forward, Zelnick has teased that new GTA games could release even faster , and that could be a positive for the company's financials.
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Preloading is underway now, and that's good news because the game has a massive file size .

news.title: 彩虹六号：维加斯据报道带着新版本回归
news.summary: Ubisoft has reportedly given a new entry in the Rainbow Six: Vegas series the green light and a codename.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/13/rainbow-six-vegas-1794596888042.png
Ubisoft has reportedly given a new entry in the Rainbow Six: Vegas series the green light and a codename.

Details on a long-awaited (and unexpected) return to a fan-favorite corner of the Rainbow Six universe come from an Insider Gaming report. The publisher is said to have given its Ubisoft Montreal team the go-ahead to begin work on a new Vegas installment, with two other projects reportedly also in the works there.

Rainbow Six: Vegas started with the release of the original game in 2006 before it returned for a sequel in 2008. Whether the new game will be called Rainbow Six: Vegas 3 or something else is unclear, though the site's sources say it's expected to be more like the former rather than something like a remake. It also stated that it's being worked on with the apt codename, "Spades."

That's just one of the three games the Montreal studio is reportedly working on. The report wasn't able to confirm much about the remaining projects but said one source suggested at least one other game is planned to take place in the Rainbow Six universe in some capacity.

The Rainbow Six franchise as a whole existed long before popular entries like Rainbow Six Siege or even the Vegas series. Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six traces all the way back to the late '90s but has splintered into a wide variety of gameplay experiences and offerings. Siege is no doubt the most well-known iteration today thanks to how Ubisoft has supported its tactical gameplay since its 2015 launch, but the most recent entry actually arrived in 2022 with Rainbow Six Extraction .

Despite nearly 20 years passing since the last Vegas game, it's remained a beloved corner of the universe for many. IGN gave the original game a 7.6/10 when it launched for PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360. We then gave the sequel's limited edition release an 8.4/10 .

Ubisoft seems to be still in the early stages of its unannounced Rainbow Six: Vegas continuation, so don't expect to see it launch for at least a few more years. While that may mean we'll have passed the 20-year mark since the last game, we hopefully won't have to wait quite as long to learn more about it. Until then, it's best to keep expectations low while the publisher keeps its cards close to its chest.

Meanwhile, we do know about a few other projects Ubisoft has up its sleeve. Rainbow Six Tactics , for example, was announced in August and will launch sometime next year. A Splinter Cell remake is also in the works, even if it's been a while since we heard from it .

news.title: 2026 年游戏大奖将首次在 Roblox 上进行直播，包括投票和虚拟商品
news.summary: The Game Awards is coming to Roblox for the first time this December, complete with live voting, virtual merch

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2024/10/08/roblox-art-1728421654301.png

The Game Awards is coming to Roblox for the first time this December, giving fans another way to watch Geoff Keighley's annual gaming shindig, complete with live voting, virtual merchandise, and the opportunity to experience the whole thing alongside other players.

The Game Awards 2026 will stream live on Roblox starting Thursday, December 10, marking the first time an external awards show has been livestreamed on the platform. The broadcast will take place in The Block, Roblox's virtual event venue, while the actual ceremony takes place at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles. There's a catch, though. Only Roblox users aged 18 and older will be able to attend the virtual watch party.

Those who are old and wizened enough to take part will be able to watch the entire broadcast, including the usual assortment of world premieres, new game announcements, awards, and musical performances. Fans will also be able to vote, interact with other viewers, and claim virtual merchandise, although exactly what that merchandise will look like remains to be seen. Official category voting will also be available ahead of the ceremony, with further details about the Roblox experience expected closer to the event.

On December 10th, #TheGameAwards makes history as the show will stream live in @Roblox for the first time. Fans 18+ will be able to watch, vote and interact LIVE alongside gaming's biggest night. More details coming soon. https://t.co/ouVtxXt7yV

The Block is no stranger to hosting major events. The virtual venue has previously been home to the Roblox Innovation Awards, alongside music experiences featuring artists including Billie Eilish, The Rolling Stones, and (K-pop fan hyperventilating) Stray Kids .

The Game Awards 2026 takes place December 10, with Geoff Keighley once again at the helm. There's no word yet on exactly how the virtual merchandise or interactive elements will work, but more details are promised in the coming weeks. It will also be available to stream through Disney+ .

At the very least, watching The Game Awards in Roblox should make for an interesting alternative to sitting through several hours of announcements while arguing about Game of the Year in a group chat. Now you can do it surrounded by avatars instead.

news.title: 报告称《GTA 6》到明年初销量将达到 5500 万份，平均售价可能为 90 美元
news.summary: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 launches on November 19, and it's expected to be a gigantic commercial success,

content.v: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 launches on November 19, and it's expected to be a gigantic commercial success, but just how big will the launch be? Investor's Business Daily compiled data from a series of analyst reports about the game and its owner, Take-Two, and the consensus is that it's going to be a juggernaut.

In terms of sales, Brian Pitz of BMO Capital Markets said GTA 6 could sell 55 million copies during Take-Two's fiscal 2027, which ends on March 31, 2027. He said the game could sell 45 million units alone during the game's launch quarter, which is well ahead of the estimates of 34.2 million that IBD compiled.

"This is an outlier in every respect," Circana's Mat Piscatella told the publication. "There have been some big game launches in the past, but nothing quite at this scale, not only in terms of the investment, but in terms of the anticipation. It's in its own league."

GTA 6 is launching with an $80 standard edition and a $100 Ultimate Edition. Raymond James analyst Andrew Marok said he's forecasting 50 million unit sales for the fiscal year 2027, and that the blended average selling price will be close to $90. According to Sensor Tower, early data suggested preorders were skewing toward the $100 edition, but by launch, it could be around 50/50 .

Matthew Cost of Morgan Stanley, meanwhile, said if GTA 6 does indeed have strong sales out of the gate, this could create a "large potential audience" for the next iteration of GTA Online . Rockstar has not said anything yet about an online mode for GTA 6, but given the huge success of GTA Online for GTA 5, it's all but guaranteed that GTA 6 will incorporate online multiplayer as well.

Cost said this is a big deal for investors and may represent "the next major catalyst" for Take-Two's stock price. Take-Two's share price is down about 10% so far in 2026 , and currently trades around $228/share..

A new version of GTA Online for GTA 6 would no doubt feature microtransactions and other ways to spend more money, and that could be frustrating for fans but great news for investors who want to see bigger returns.

D.A. Davidson analyst Wyatt Swanson said Take-Two's share price could surge to $300 in part because he believes Rockstar will release a PC edition of GTA 6 and usher in GTA Online 2.0. These releases would "enable structurally higher margins" for Take-Two, he said.

According to Sensor Tower, GTA 6 has already sold 12 million copies and generated $1.2 billion in revenue . GTA 5, meanwhile, took 72 hours to clear $1 billion in revenue --GTA 6 reached that a week before release, apparently.
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

news.summary: Preorders for Magic: The Gathering’s Nauctis: The Sunken Realm are now live at Amazon.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/13/nauctis-the-sunken-realm-mtg-preorders-1794597718585.png
Magic: The Gathering’s Star Trek set launched today, but Wizards of the Coast isn’t messing around - with Nauctis: The Sunken Realm previews kicking off at Magic Con Atlanta .

If you’re looking to dive under the waves on launch day, we’d recommend preordering soon. Thankfully, Amazon has just opened its preorders for Play Boosters, Collector Boosters, Commander Decks, and more.
Amazon Has Nauctis: The Sunken Realm Ready For Preorder

Nauctis: The Sunken Realm launches on February 5, 2027, but you can already preorder just about everything. It’s worth noting right from the jump that there are “God Packs” included in the rotation now, wherein every card in a pack is rare or mythic. The odds are minuscule that you’ll pull one, and the jury is out on how worthwhile they are, but it’s worth knowing going in.

Up first, Play Boosters are a great way to rack up a collection relatively quickly, and they’re up for $164.70 for a box of 30 . You don’t save anything on the MSRP of $5.49 per pack, but if the price drops (which often does happen), you’ll save the difference.
Don’t want a full Play Booster box but keen on a few packs? The Nauctis: Sunken Realm Bundle is $57.99 and includes 9 Play Booster Packs, as well as art cards, a promo card, and more.

Next up, Collector Boosters. Not only can you currently grab these solus for $26.99 , but we’re that close to the reveal that a box is available for $323.88 . Yes, it’s crazy expensive compared to Play Boosters, but that’s the way to get your most valuable cards - plus a Sunken Treasures Box Topper.
Commander players, there’s good news: There are four decks coming with this set, as well as Premium Edition versions with all-foil cards.

There’s a $200 bundle that includes all four basic versions , as well as the option to buy them piecemeal. There are the Sultai deck, Terrors of the Abyss , Prismari Blood in the Water , the Boros Seal the Deal , and the Bant Merfolk Regiment . Each is $49.99 at the moment.
At present, Amazon has the Premium Edition bundled up for $319.96 , which includes all four in foil.

Finally, the Secret Lair bundle is back, as is Draft Night. The former includes two Collector Boosters, six Play Boosters, 20 full-art lands and an exclusive spindown die, and will set you back $89.99 - but we expect it to be snapped up quickly.
Draft Night gives you 12 Play Booster Packs to play draft games with your friends, and 90 lands to build decks, as well as a Collector Booster for the victor. It’s $89.99, too.

news.title: 你可能会猜到《魔兽世界》：永远最受欢迎的种族、阶级和派系
news.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever has been in the wild for one week, and now we have all kinds of stats to sink our t

content.v: World of Warcraft: Forever has been in the wild for one week, and now we have all kinds of stats to sink our teeth into as they relate to the most popular races, classes, and faction in the latest version of developer Blizzard's MMORPG.

Forever launched November 4, becoming the biggest launch in WoW history by concurrent and returning players. Aside from that fact, Blizzard hasn't shared additional information on exactly how many characters have been made or what classes are most popular.
For that, we turn to Raider.IO , a WoW stat-tracking website more commonly used in the modern version of the game to provide rankings and details related to raids and Mythic+ progression.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/WoW-Forever-RaiderIO-stats.jpg?w=636

According to the site, close to 3.9 million characters have been created across all regions and rulesets so far. Around 48% of those characters are on the Alliance, with nearly 52% being on the Horde.

The most popular two races aren't all that surprising--undead and humans. Despite being the most boring choice imaginable, humans have always been a popular choice in WoW Classic thanks to their strong passives and the ability to be most classes. In Forever, they currently make up 37% of the Alliance population. Undead, on the other hand, are getting a massive boost from being the only Horde race to currently have access to Paladin. They make up nearly 40% of the Horde.
It won't shock you to learn then that Paladin is Forever's most-played class, with undead Paladin being the most-played race-and-class combo.

Skyborne elves are WoW's newest playable race, available to both factions. Around 10% of all characters are Skyborne, and faction-wise they are fairly even. Around 10% of Skyborne are Alliance and close to 11% are on the Horde. Consdiering how popular blood elves are in other versions of the game, the number of Skyborne feels low by comparison, though the fact they cost $30 to access probably has something to do with that.

As for what rulesets are most popular, the normal (PvE) server is far and away the biggest, with over 2 million characters. The PvP ruleset isn't too far behind with around 1.5 million characters. Those two rulesets dwarf the size of the game's two RP rulesets, which combined have around 250,000 players.

With the exception of standard RP, every ruleset has a larger Horde population, a subject Blizzard recently commented on officially. In a forum post , Blizzard announced its goal is for PvP servers to be as close to 50/50 faction balance as possible, and would be placing restrictions on creating Horde characters on PvP rulesets in an effort to make that a reality.

"World of Warcraft: Forever's PvP is at its best when the Alliance and Horde are on equal footing, and we are dedicated to helping maintain that balance so that we can all witness battles at the epic scale that has made WoW: Forever PvP so memorable thus far," Blizzard said.

One week after WoW: Forever's shockingly smooth launch , we've been impressed how visual updates and Blizzard's changes to the classic WoW formula have made the MMO feel brand new again . Forever received its first major class and dungeon changes earlier this week.

news.title: 塞尔达传说官方网站将 3DS 游戏标记为可在 Switch 上玩，这引起了人们的注意
news.summary: Nintendo is celebrating The Legend of Zelda's 40th anniversary in many different ways, but one detail on the c

content.v: Nintendo is celebrating The Legend of Zelda's 40th anniversary in many different ways, but one detail on the company's official website raised confusion--and curiosity-- about a classic 3DS Zelda game.

A "History" page on Nintendo's website lists every mainline Zelda game in release order, including the release date and which platforms you can play for each entry. The site marks every game that's playable for Nintendo Switch Online subscribers--and the 2013 3DS game The Legend of Zelda: A Link Between Worlds was marked as such. The NSO icon has since been removed from the site.

Currently, the Nintendo Classics library allows NSO subscribers to play select NES, SNES, and Game Boy games, while the Expansion Pack subscription includes access to Nintendo 64, Game Boy Advance, GameCube, and Virtual Boy games. There's currently no way to play 3DS games on Nintendo Switch, prompting the question of whether this was an error on Nintendo's website or an accidental leak that A Link Between Worlds will somehow be playable on Switch. GameSpot has reached out to Nintendo for clarification on the matter.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Screenshot-2026-11-13-113221.png

The site appropriately labels the Zelda games featured on Nintendo Classics if they are only playable with the Nintendo Switch Online Expansion Pack subscription, which applies to Ocarina of Time ( the original ), Majora's Mask, A Link to the Past/Four Swords on GBA, The Wind Waker, and The Minish Cap.

If this labeling for A Link Between Worlds were true, it would be surprising if the Expansion Pack were not required to play it. Nintendo Classics also lacks any Wii or DS games, so jumping straight to 3DS would be a bizarre move for the service.

Whatever the case, A Link Between Worlds is a magnificent entry in the Zelda series that deserves to be experienced. GameSpot's 9/10 review of the game called it an "absolute treat to play" with some of the "best Zelda dungeons in years."

news.title: 专家表示，GTA 6 和其他游戏的 80 美元价格是合理的
news.summary: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 finally releases on November 19, and you'll have to pay at least $80 for it. Tha

content.v: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 finally releases on November 19, and you'll have to pay at least $80 for it. That's a full $20 more than what GTA 5 cost in 2013 and $10 more than many other big AAA games today. Is $80 going to become the "new normal" for AAA games, or is it, along with Nintendo's Mario Kart World and Tears of the Kingdom for Switch 2 , an outlier at $80?

According to Alinea Analytics researcher Rhys Elliott , $80 won't be an across-the-board new price for all games. Some developers will purposefully price their games lower to draw in more consumers--he pointed to games like Expedition 33 ($50), Phantom Blade Zero ($60), and Oblivion Remastered ($50) as examples.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Ambrosia_06_a679c3.jpg?w=636

Elliott said that when GTA 6 inevitably becomes a huge success with its $80 and $100 editions, some publishers will be "jumping for joy" because they'll take this as a signal that the market will indeed accept these higher prices.

However, Elliott said he hopes the industry doesn't learn the wrong lessons from GTA 6 and its $80 price point. "GTA 6 is as inelastic as things get in entertainment. People will pay anything to get their mitts on this one, which makes it seem like the perfect Trojan horse for an industry-wide price rise," he said.

"The $80 price point will be a Godsend to some publishers, but it’ll be a snowball's chance in hell for others. After all, this kind of stuff can be zero-sum. When a player spends $100 on GTA 6, their remaining budget shrinks," he added.

Elliott went on to list off some of the studios and game franchises that could likely get their fanbases to buy in at $80. He said these include the next big God of War game after Laufey, the next Naughty Dog game, Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet, and future Forza titles (assuming Xbox strips them out of Game Pass). Additionally, Elliott said From Software "has the cache" to charge $80 for its new games, while Hogwarts Legacy 2 could also up the price to $80. Elliott added that some of the top sports games could charge more, but that might be a tougher sell considering those games are full of microtransactions already.
"So not all games were created equal, and mid-tier AAA publishers--and also bigger publishers offering smaller games or remakes--will price downward at $40-$60," Elliott said.

There are a lot of factors at play here. For starters, GTA 5 launched at $60 back in 2013, and that same $60 is worth $86 today after inflation, making GTA 6--at least its $80 edition--effectively cheaper than GTA 5 .

At the same time, many people are acutely aware that their pay has not kept up with inflation, while the federal minimum wage hasn't moved up since 2009. GTA 6 is also coming out at a rough time for many people, with gas and grocery prices surging , and the cost of everyday goods generally spiking due in part to increasing inflation. And anyone heading to a store to buy a console to play GTA 6 on is in for some serious sticker shock, as game consoles today are more expensive than ever due to the AI craze.

New video games generally staying the same price over the years has had serious negative effects on the entire industry, experts have said. It's part of the reason why publishers now try to squeeze people more with DLC, battle passes, microtransactions, collector's editions, paid early access, and more. Recently, an Xbox advertising chief said price increases would be a hard sell, so the company is turning to ads to help offset ballooning budgets and keep the business healthy.

news.title: GTA 6 游戏内电视节目 Macca & Friends 看起来很荒谬
news.summary: Rockstar Games has released the first footage of an in-game GTA 6 TV show called "Macca & Friends," which is a

content.v: Rockstar Games has released the first footage of an in-game GTA 6 TV show called "Macca & Friends," which is about a sunglass-wearing pink alligator and his wetland friends in Leonida (the stand-in for Florida).

One of Macca's friends is Pinchie the crab, who is Macca's landlord. Macca is also friends with a hat-wearing manatee and a flamingo. Check out the trailer below, which sets up a story where Macca needs to get money to pay his landlord. The story involves the group seemingly posing as cops and sneaking into a police station, maybe to grab some cash from an evidence locker?

Macca & Friends will be available to watch on Weazel, which is GTA's version of Fox. For now, all we have is this teaser. Given Rockstar's extreme push toward depth and immersion, we wouldn't be surprised if Macca & Friends is an actual multi-episode TV show in GTA 6 that people can watch on their in-game couch.
GTA 6 has an impressive attention to detail, so much so that a lot of what Rockstar created, fans may never even see .
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Preloading is underway now, and that's good news because the game is 212GB.

news.title: PS5 的新图形升级技巧正在扩展到更多游戏
news.summary: Sony has announced that several more games are getting a Quick Spectral Super Resolution (QSSR) upgrade on PS5

content.v: Sony has announced that several more games are getting a Quick Spectral Super Resolution (QSSR) upgrade on PS5. Introduced in September, QSSR is an AI-guided upscaling technology similar to the PS5 Pro's PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR), and it originally supported only Marvel's Wolverine and Ghost of Yotei. That lineup is expanding over the next couple of weeks to include games like Control Resonant, Marvel's Spider-Man 2, Arc Raiders, The Finals, No Man's Sky, and Hell Let Loose: Vietnam.

While it's not quite as good as PSSR on the PS5 Pro, QSSR still does a noticeable job of adding detail and clarity without impacting performance. Sony added that since QSSR shares elements with PSSR, it makes games that support the PS5 Pro upscaling tech a "natural" fit for an upgrade on regular PS5 consoles.

Marvel's Spider-Man 2 is a good example, given Insomniac Games' familiarity with PSSR. The QSSR update is now available for the game, and Insomniac's head of technology, Mike Fitzgerald, said it'll apply to both Fidelity and Performance modes. For Control Resonant, Remedy Entertainment senior graphics programmer Erik Jansson said that QSSR will offer noticeable improvements in image stability and fine detail, and the update will be available in December.

While there's no exact date for when Arc Raiders and The Finals will be updated, players can expect "increased sharpness, better environmental clarity and overall visual improvements," according to Embarl Studios technical art director Mikael Linderholm. Hello Games founder Sean Murray said that the No Man's Sky QSSR update will be out in a "few weeks" and will see the game look sharper on PS5 while maintaining "the best possible" frame rate.

Finally, Paul Rustchynsky, game director at Expression Games, said that Hell Let Loose: Vietnam will also look cleaner and sharper on PS5 when the update is eventually available. If you're interested in seeing how different several of the games look with QSSR enabled, you can click the links below to see comparison videos:

The PS5 turns six years old later this month, and as of November 10, it has surpassed 100 million consoles sold. Ordinarily, all eyes would be on the next PlayStation generation at this point-- which Sony says it is working on --and advances like QSSR may squeeze more life out of the PS5 before its successor arrives . Whatever form the next PlayStation takes, don't expect it to be cheap, as the current generation has gotten more expensive since 2020 and the PS6 could cost over $1,000 . Former PlayStation boss Shawn Layden recently touched on the topic, and he spoke about how true innovation from Sony would come in the form of cheaper hardware, not just better graphics.

news.title: Xbox 表示，在游戏中添加没人喜欢的广告可能有助于拯救游戏业
news.summary: Xbox Cloud Gaming now has a free ad-supported version that's rolling out as part of Microsoft's bigger push to

content.v: Xbox Cloud Gaming now has a free ad-supported version that's rolling out as part of Microsoft's bigger push to bring more ads to Xbox. Jonathan Stringfield, who worked on Activision's advertising push and is now doing some of the same work in his title as GM for Xbox Media Solutions, said in an interview that people shouldn't see this as a move by Xbox to cram ads into all of its games.

“There is zero world where there is intention--written, explicit, implicit, or otherwise--that ads will be an option in all games. It might not even be the case on all features of the console, et cetera,” he told GamesBeat . “Where we want to have these integrated is places where it makes sense--where it can actually provide value in a positive way. Even if that means the total reach that we can have is going to be perhaps smaller than if we brute-forced it, that’s okay."
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Xbox-2.png?w=636

Stringfield went on to point out how the gaming industry today is at a crossroads if the existing model is to survive. Many are saying it won't, or shouldn't, but Stringfield said if it does, then companies either need to "dramatically increase the price of games" or "find other mechanisms" that allow companies to make more money and keep the business healthy.
Stringfield, whose job is to help sell ads, said ads could be a way forward.
“When we talk about advertising--and things that are adjacent to it that amount to recurrent revenue, whether it’s subscriptions or otherwise--what this allows for is an alternative," he said.
Xbox chief strategy officer, Matthew Ball, previously said Xbox's intention was not to "cram ads in everything."

“Ads should be used to offer more affordable alternatives alongside today’s ad-free experiences, in the hopes more could play as a result. Similar to how Netflix and Disney+ have ad tiers with all the same content, but at half the price or so,” he said. “At no point do I even mention in-game ads. I personally believe interrupting the gameplay experience would be bad.”

For Xbox Cloud Gaming, users can now stream their own games for free with ad-supported cloud gaming. Alternatively, people can purchase ad-free cloud playtime, or they can subscribe to Xbox Game Pass to get more time. However, starting this month, Xbox is putting hourly caps on how much people can stream before requiring them to pay more.
The ads on Xbox Cloud Gaming come in the form of pre-roll ads that people watch before getting into a game; they don't interrupt gameplay, however.

Video game prices have remained largely flat over the years, and this is part of the problem, some experts have said. Without price increases, the math just doesn't math when development costs and other expenses are factored in. For his part, Stringfield said price increases for games would not be "terribly popular," so he's looking at other systems, namely ads, to fill the gap.

The biggest game of 2026, Rockstar's GTA 6 , costs $80 for its standard edition, scaling up to $100 for the Ultimate Edition and $400 for a collector's edition (which doesn't include the game) . For comparison, GTA 5 launched in 2013 at $60--that same $60 is worth about $86 today after inflation. This is why Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick believes GTA 6 is a true bargain --it's "cheaper" than GTA 5 was some 13 years ago, he says.
But GTA 6 isn't the first game to charge $80--Nintendo ushered in this new era in 2025 with Mario Kart World.

People like former PlayStation executive Shawn Layden have said for years that companies refusing to raise prices was actually detrimental and has caused numerous systemic problems , contributing to the situation the industry finds itself in. Layden said the price of new games ought to have gone up $10 for each new console generation, and when that didn’t happen, companies made efforts to extract more money from people with things like microtransactions, battle passes, and subscriptions.

One Bank of America analyst believes the rest of the industry should follow Rockstar and start charging $80 for games . If more companies raise prices to $80 like Rockstar is doing with GTA 6, that doesn’t mean developers will stop hawking things like microtransactions, DLC, and battle passes. Instead, these efforts to increase ARPU will likely continue in concert with price hikes because why would a company cut off, or scale back, a revenue stream?

news.title: 在您读完本标题之前，Xbox 25 周年纪念主机补货已售罄
news.summary: After quickly selling out earlier this year, Microsoft dropped a limited number of its 25th Anniversary Xbox S

content.v: After quickly selling out earlier this year, Microsoft dropped a limited number of its 25th Anniversary Xbox Series X consoles for sale this week-- aaaaannnd they're already gone . Easily the best-looking Xbox Series X console thanks to its transparent green case, it looks like the majority of people looking to get one of these are out of luck, unless they're willing to pony up and pay extra for one of these consoles on sites like eBay, where they're currently being listed at next-gen console prices.

Naturally, fans who missed out are livid, and online, they're calling out Xbox's first-come first-serve business model for selling the console, as opposed to a method like a lottery system that would even the playing field. Several disappointed buyers say that scalpers and bots go to all the remaining stock first, as they claim that it was sold out within seconds once again. People are especially mad at GameStop, as its dynamic pricing system had the console up for sale at the eye-watering price of $4,950, not including tax.

Over on eBay, beggars can't be choosers, as people continue to pay an inflated price for this Xbox Series X. Sales of it are averaging around $2,500 per console, a significant mark-up from the $900 MSRP of the device. In comparison, both Nintendo and Sony have implemented lottery and queue-based reservation systems in the past, specifically designed to thwart scalpers and filter out automated bots. Last year for the rollout of the Switch 2 in Japan, Nintendo utilized an official lottery system via the My Nintendo Store, which saw over 2 million people enter.

In western markets, Nintendo offered a direct invitation queue via regional Nintendo Accounts for verified active account holders. Sony's PS5 Pro has also become a hot item ahead of the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6, and recently, Sony instituted an anti-scalping lottery system via the official Sony Store in Japan. To qualify for the draw, entrants were required to have a Japanese PlayStation Network account and a verified history of at least 60 hours of playtime on a PS4 or PS5 across the preceding two years.
But with Xbox hardware sales reaching historic lows recently ? Microsoft probably isn't too worried about who buys its consoles, so long as it sells them.

news.title: 《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版：在变与不变中巧妙平衡
news.summary: 这不是一篇很客观的文章。我是在通关《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版后，怀着兴奋、感动，又略感空虚的心情动笔的。 为此特意入手了塞尔达40周年限定主机 《塞尔达传说 时之笛》是游戏史上评分最高的作品，奠定了现代第三人称3D动作

content.v: 这不是一篇很客观的文章。我是在通关《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版后，怀着兴奋、感动，又略感空虚的心情动笔的。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14626/77fad1889e4851d15b2d630c1deec508.jpeg_mw680water
为此特意入手了塞尔达40周年限定主机
《塞尔达传说 时之笛》是游戏史上评分最高的作品，奠定了现代第三人称3D动作冒险游戏的基础范式，影响延续至今。
这份过去的成就，既是往日的荣耀，也是如今重制时的枷锁。如何在保留原始体验与现代化改良之间取得平衡，是一道难题。而《时之笛》重制版的团队对此有着清晰的认知，交出了一份出色的答卷。
要说Switch 2的重制版有什么改变，最直观的自然是画面。但它并非简单地把画面做得更漂亮、更清晰，而是为整个世界加入了丰富的细节，让人觉得海拉鲁是一个真实存在的世界。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14626/9e6432c7c68a5dcf179e985e248dd6b6.jpeg_mw680water
举几个例子：当你割下水边的花草时，它们会漂浮在水面上。
地下洞穴的墙壁上，渗出的地下水会汇聚成涓涓细流。
吹奏陶笛时，林克的手指会按照真实的指法在笛身上起落。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14626/a3e7bea2e20bebb1e0a2b28bb073a90e.jpeg_mw680water
对细节的追求还体现在服装设计上。原有的角色造型都增添了许多细节，比如林克服装上的编织与刺绣，玛蓉的服装则换成了更直观的小马花纹。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14626/8dac7e58dbdae839d182bc0befb48160.jpeg_mw680water
为了呈现童年林克服饰那种“森林里的孩子们亲手缝制”的手工质感，制作组专门查阅了博物馆中的相关资料，还在现实中缝制了实物布料作为参考。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14626/5b3f8d2438b3a8c2d9e3e9a8ab186f36.jpeg_mw680water
重制版的音乐改用管弦乐编制，剧情演出也全部重制，关键剧情处还加入了配音，大幅提升了游玩时的沉浸感。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14626/4e82056bddbdc0a1414cc01e6a5b957c.jpeg_mw680water
在游玩体验上，重制版大幅优化了操作：稳定的60帧表现，类似《旷野之息》的道具快捷切换，新增的跳跃，可自由切换的视角，以及陀螺仪瞄准，都让玩家更容易上手。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14626/95f0d3d0e232fd9f893610827ddea91a.png_mw680water
毕竟，如今再让青沼英二玩原版时之笛，在水之神殿反复打开菜单切换道具，他也一定会烦得玩不下去。
虽然操作方式与以往不同，但线性的玩法、谜题的逻辑与框架都没有改变。以一两件关键道具为核心设计的箱庭迷宫挑战，利用时之笛穿越时空的冒险，都原汁原味地保留了下来。
具体迷宫的提示也更加清晰。比如原作中令无数玩家崩溃的水之神殿，需要切换水位的那三处机关，如今都用不同颜色做了醒目标记。这虽然在一定程度上降低了谜题难度，但整体提示依旧相当克制，会引导你主动思考该用怎样的道具和机关破局，也不会削弱你解开谜题后的成就感。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14626/27e118e31a28233f0efcf5173c4e654b.jpeg_mw680water
门口的图标，代表可调整的水位高度
玩重制版时，Nintendo Switch App里的Zelda Note也是不可错过的一项功能。App除了显示地图、自带成就系统，还能显示各类收集要素的具体位置，以及每个区域的完成度，绝对是全收集玩家的福音。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14626/2e925dcd484f338aa540a78f6d362782.jpeg_mw680water
其实我是来晒100%探索度的
App里事无巨细的进度截图也值得一看，说不定还藏着些奇奇怪怪的东西，比如：
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14626/aafc00f9fa49c4f553e50411696ad3dd.png_mw680water
乐极生悲？
不过重制版也并非完美，高难度“里时之笛”模式的缺失就颇为遗憾。另外，游戏只有一个手动存档位，通关后无法开新档重玩，只能覆盖原来的通关存档……
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14626/8f0b7c6b799e16976d907846ff07f18b.jpeg_mw680water
《时之笛3D》中的里时之笛模式
出于整体体验的考虑，制作组在尝试之后没有为游戏加入传送点。但以我自己的体验来说，还是希望游戏能增加一些传送点，或者为牧场增设一首传送曲。有些谜题需要反复切换时间线，或是在多个场景之间奔波，缺少传送点带来的重复赶路，确实有些枯燥。
总而言之，《时之笛》重制版值得一玩。
塞尔达系列的灵感，起源于宫本茂童年在住处附近的山野间四处探索的回忆。而《时之笛》重制版，无疑正是能带来这种冒险体验的优秀作品。

news.title: 立即获取比标准版更便宜的《合金装备 Delta: Snake Eater》和所有奖励 DLC
news.summary: I don’t think there’s ever been a more iconic sound than the ‘!’ noise that triggers when you’re spotted in Me

content.v: I don’t think there’s ever been a more iconic sound than the ‘!’ noise that triggers when you’re spotted in Metal Gear Solid. Even when I was a little kid, my first exposure to the franchise was through the Mesal Gear Solid: Snake Escape minigame in Ape Escape 3. That’s not really relevant, besides the fact that it shares a similar name with Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater , a remake and an absolute blast that’s now cheaper than ever, with all DLC included.

If you ask anyone who has played the series, there’s a good chance that Snake Eater might be their favorite. Personally, I’m a sucker for The Phantom Pain and, of course, Metal Gear Rising—but a majority of fans love this one, and I can’t blame them. A prequel to the rest of the series, meaning it’s a perfect jumping-on point for interested newcomers, you play as Naked Snake, sent to Tselinoyarsk, USSR, to complete Operation: Virtuous Mission. But, like any secret mission, things go awry.

Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater is, narratively, the same game as the original, so fans shouldn’t expect anything too different from the 2004 version. Instead, the gameplay is fine-tuned with some quality-of-life changes, while keeping the stealth combat at its core the same. Just with a fresh coat of paint slapped on, of course.

And I’m really underselling it with the fresh coat of paint line. Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater completely refreshes the original, bringing it up to modern standards, with every element across the board brought to the current generation. Naked Snake has never looked so beautiful, and even one look at different screenshots for a direct comparison will show you just how overhauled the experience is.

In our Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater review , Tamoor said, while playing the game, “I wasn’t an adult yearning for the lost feelings that made me love Metal Gear Solid 3; I was the teenager living them for the first time again.” And, as an added bonus, that Ape Escape mission is still part of the Snake Eater experience. That’s purchase-worthy alone.

If you’re looking to play the game for the first time ever, or you’re hoping to relive your life two decades ago, you can grab the Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater Deluxe Edition for just $27.29 / £22.74 at Fanatical , getting you a Steam key with all of the bonus content at a lower price than Steam has ever offered the standard edition for. Not a bad way to celebrate November.
Disclosure: GameSpot and Fanatical are both owned by Fandom. This story was created in collaboration with Fanatical’s deals team.

news.title: “你们这些家伙都是白痴”：杰夫·卡普兰瞄准暴雪的《守望先锋 2》揭晓
news.summary: Saying Overwatch 2 has had a rocky road since its 2019 reveal would be an understatement, and former Overwatch

content.v: Saying Overwatch 2 has had a rocky road since its 2019 reveal would be an understatement, and former Overwatch director Jeff Kaplan isn't a fan of how the game was first announced.

Speaking to Gaming World Interviews , Kaplan didn't mince words about the BlizzCon 2019 opening ceremony, where Overwatch 2 was shown for the first time, as Blizzard promised numerous features it either walked back or didn't deliver.

Kaplan said that from 2018 until his departure, he experienced constant friction with Blizzard's executive leadership over game direction, scheduling, and core game mechanics. This led him to confront leadership about the lack of a clear vision or business model for Overwatch 2, and to question the wisdom of announcing Overwatch 2 at the same time as Diablo 4.

"I got in a huge fight with, at the time, it wasn't Mike [Morhaime]. I loved Mike, who was the president of Blizzard, and another president of Blizzard, my executive producer, over announcing Overwatch 2. I went into their office, I’m like, 'What are we doing? We don’t really know what this game is; we don’t know what the business model is. This is a huge mistake.'"

According to Kaplan, the new executives "had a lot to prove" when they joined Blizzard. "They wanted to prove that 'Blizzard's back and Blizzard still has it.' And I'm like, 'You guys are f***ing idiots,' you know? I don’t know how else to put it, but after three years of just getting worn down and not agreeing with any of the decisions that were being made on the franchise and not feeling like I had agency anymore--like before it used to be like I'm the game director I get to decide the direction the game goes. And starting in 2018, I lost that, and after three years of fighting for it back, I realized this company belongs to these corporate people now, the Blizzard executive team, the Activision team."

Kaplan left Blizzard in 2021, saying Activision Blizzard’s financial arm told him that if Overwatch didn't meet certain financial goals, 1,000 people at the company would be laid off and the blame would fall on him. "The biggest f**k you moment I’ve had in my career--it felt surreal to be in that condition," Kaplan said earlier this year .

These days, Kaplan is working on The Legend of California at the new studio he co-founded, Kintsugiyama. The Blizzard veteran recently spoke to GameSpot about the "humbling" reality of being an indie dev and more.

news.title: 《神鬼寓言》看起来比我们想象的要黑暗得多
news.summary: Amid a modest 25th-anniversary celebration , Xbox dropped a new preview of the Fable reboot. This snippet — wh

content.v: Amid a modest 25th-anniversary celebration , Xbox dropped a new preview of the Fable reboot. This snippet — which runs for under four minutes — offers plenty of gameplay and a closer look at some of the ghoulish enemies you'll face, set in a slice of Albion that looks surprisingly grim compared to the lighthearted Fable teasers that came before it.

"The Hero of Briar Hill has entered the depths of Deepwood alongside Arden, a local Hero, to investigate why strange magical happenings have been troubling the people of Oakshire," the video synopsis reads. "Here, they cross a threshold where the natural magic of Deepwood appears corrupted by an outside force, and they discover hints as to who or what could be responsible."

One thing to note about this snippet of gameplay is that it's pulled from the PC build of Fable, with the settings cranked up to Ultra. It's a pretty good-looking glimpse of what you can expect from Fable next year, even if it feels different from its cheekier predecessors and more like a feudal action slice reminiscent of Control Resonant toward the end, with its red-hued aesthetic.

Of course, four minutes of Fable doesn't tell the whole story, and with the main campaign alone estimated to take 20 hours to finish , that doom-and-gloom feeling probably won't be present throughout the entire game.

Fable launches February 23, 2027, for Xbox Series X|S, PS5, and PC, with Playground Games primarily handling development. Turn 10 Studios also assisted with development, and following recent changes at Xbox, it was merged into Playground Games.

In addition to Fable, Xbox also revealed that new Wolfenstein and Doom games are in development, and Xbox CEO Asha Sharma’s open letter to the Xbox community suggested that future game development might be more reliant on AI .

news.title: 4款任天堂独占PC民间移植遭下架！但砍掉一个冒出俩
news.summary: 四个项目被移除，涉及马力欧与塞尔达系列，任天堂未公开回应。

content.v: 最近，游戏反编译领域发生了不小的变化。随着玩家开始利用AI进行所谓的“Vibe Coding”，他们能够相对轻松地拆解游戏的二进制代码，并将其转换为C++，从而把原本主机独占的游戏移植到Windows和Linux PC平台。显然，游戏开发商已经注意到了这一现象，尤其是以诉讼闻名的任天堂。据The Gamer报道，就在今天，任天堂发起了新一轮DMCA（数字千年版权法）打击，导致四款大型粉丝移植项目被下架。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/13/cas_auto/small_0_9410324.jpg
据报道，四个大型游戏反编译项目已经从代码托管平台上被移除，推测是因为任天堂对此表示了不满。遭到下架的项目分别是：Project Tandem（《马里奥赛车：双重冲刺》）、PowerMoon（《超级马里奥：奥德赛》）、MTF-Recomp（《马里奥网球：狂热》）以及SkyRecomp（《塞尔达传说：天空之剑HD》）。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/13/cas_auto/small_0_9410325.jpg
显然，任天堂的法务团队向这些项目的上传者发出了法律警告。PowerMoon的开发者在Reddit上发布了一则帖子，解释了项目遭到下架的情况，并表示：“我不能透露具体发生了什么，但只能说，我不会尝试与之对抗。”
不过，The Gamer指出，不过，任天堂面临的问题在于，一旦这些游戏项目传播到互联网上，几乎所有人都能获取它们。这有点像九头蛇：砍掉一个脑袋，就会冒出两个新的，而这次也确实发生了类似的情况。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/13/cas_auto/small_0_9410326.jpg
PowerMoon遭到下架仅仅几个小时后，就有另一名用户重新上传了该项目，并声称加入了一些“重大改进”。于是，这场较量逐渐演变成了一场大型猫鼠游戏：任天堂不断尝试删除这些重新出现的项目，而它们却一次又一次地卷土重来。未来，这种情况只会变得更加难以应对。

news.title: 《红色沙漠》DLC“未知征途”Fami 通评测：无尽沧海
news.summary: 一提到开放世界游戏的 DLC 内容，很多人可能下意识都会觉得是“追加新区域和几个小时的额外剧情”。但由 Pearl Abyss 开发的《红色沙漠》所推出的全新的 DLC“未知征途”却完全打破了这一刻板印象。 这部讲述后日

content.v: 一提到开放世界游戏的 DLC 内容，很多人可能下意识都会觉得是“追加新区域和几个小时的额外剧情”。但由 Pearl Abyss 开发的《红色沙漠》所推出的全新的 DLC“未知征途”却完全打破了这一刻板印象。
这部讲述后日谈故事的 DLC 在游戏本体发售仅 7 个月之后便火速推出（2026 年 10 月 30 日发售），但即便如此，其内容量也堪称恐怖，甚至称得上是又端上了一盘超大份的主菜。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/71bdce235949365f4e67cf2ab803fa62/
笔者在 4 月份花了大约 300 个小时通关 PC 版本体的主线剧情之后，一度进入了半年左右的倦怠期，期间几乎没再打开过游戏。在这样的情况下深入游玩刚刚上线的 DLC 内容之后，我最终给出的结论是“只要你喜欢之前的本体，那该 DLC 绝对是一部让你大呼过瘾的杰作，但其中也潜藏着不少出人意料的机制与陷阱”。
大幅优化的角色养成体验
在开始体验 DLC 相关内容之前，首先让我感到惊讶的，便是游戏相较发售初期发生的巨大变化。
在 8 月份推出免费大型更新《红色沙漠：增强版》后，游戏的系统得到了大幅升级优化。在 4 月之前，玩家还需要分别投入资源去培养克里夫、达米安和翁卡。但现在角色养成系统简化了不少，基本上已经变成了“只需要培养一个角色，三人共享养成进度”的状态。
……既然如此，那我早些时候费心费力把三名角色都培养起来的辛劳不就白费了吗？！但也正因为有那段痛苦的经历，我才能更加深刻地体会到游玩便捷性的显著提升。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/f848799cf246f4efe0ac9a37897564ad/
此外，主线流程还新增了不少过场动画和世界观补充说明，并且实装了日语配音。用日语配音来体验故事，无疑能让玩家更加直观地了解主角克里夫的内心世界，代入感会有明显提升，这也是为什么笔者现在已经开启了二周目的游玩。
航向浩瀚沧海
接下来正式进入 DLC 的内容。本作的最大卖点无疑是“驾船前往大海上冒险”的玩法。在本就十分辽阔的本体地图之外，该 DLC 又额外追加了一片一望无际的汪洋大海。而且，不单单是在水面上航行，玩家甚至可以潜入海中进行探索。
整片海洋区域被设计得十分立体，既有海面上的群岛，又有海底的遗迹与珍宝。这么做带来的结果，就是 DLC 的地图规模甚至达到了本体的 4 倍左右。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/8116049ca7f4813d771749cc04675c99/
极高的探索密度本就是原版《红色沙漠》的一大魅力所在，如今这种密度又被拓展到了海洋之上。因此自 DLC 推出以来，几乎每天都有玩家在源源不断地公布自己的新发现，简直太惊人了！甚至让人忍不住想吐槽一句“开发团队是不是压根就不想让玩家通关啊”。
顺带一提，《红色沙漠》发售初期 Pearl Abyss 的超高更新频率曾一度引发热议，他们也一直把这种节奏维持到了现在，几乎每天都会推送新的修复补丁。
靠蛮力打破常规海战的桎梏
出发探索大海之前，玩家可以让其他“灰鬃”成员们一并登船，为海战做准备。本作的海战系统与该类型的标杆作品《刺客信条 4：黑旗》没有太大区别，但是考虑到《刺客信条 4：黑旗》刚刚才推出了完全重制版，如果单纯从炮击战的体验和掌舵手感来说，本作难免还是会略逊一筹。
那这是否意味着本作的海战体验很无趣呢？事实上恰恰相反。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/1eec34d70c179fdeda53fcad158fc6e1/
如果厌倦了常规的炮击拉扯，你完全可以大手一挥跳上敌人的船只，或者在水上狂奔，直接冲上对手的甲板。接下来你只需要在甲板上大闹一番，把敌方船员一网打尽，然后破坏船只就能取得海战的胜利。
顺带一提，你甚至可以开着机甲使用激光炮把敌船轰沉，或者召唤飞龙把敌人全都烤成焦炭。
这种可以无视传统海战的规则，直接靠蛮力剿灭对手的超高自由度正是本作海战体验的精髓所在。在主打海战体验的游戏作品当中，这份爽快感绝对是独一无二的，还请各位务必亲自上手体验一番。
更富戏剧性的后日谈故事
后日谈剧情自然是该 DLC 的另一大卖点，其剧本的戏剧性相较本体也有了明显的提升。其中最令我印象深刻的，就是达米安和翁卡的故事。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/10b67833bbd394bb024b3efda5d326e0/
达米安篇主要描绘的是在击败幕后操纵国家的本篇 Boss 之后，整个国家内部混乱动荡的政治局势。这段剧情最出彩的地方，就在于原本在主角一行人视角下十恶不赦的人物，却在百姓眼里被塑造成了一位功过参半的执政者。
失去执政者之后，国家的政治局势陷入一片混乱，最终遭殃的也还是普通的平民。无论是首都的破败景象、挤满街头的难民还是在暗中勾心斗角的野心家都得到了细致的刻画，这对于刚刚经历了中期选举，现在居住在美国的笔者而言，简直太感同身受了。
除此以外，剧情表现给人最大冲击的，还得是翁卡。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/32d227fac151ead89efe88717b8740ed/
翁卡是在本篇剧情的晚期才加入队伍（通关第 7 章之后），因此在正式版发售时，他的存在感一直比较薄弱。但在这次的 DLC 里，他那种立誓要辅佐主角克里夫的坚定信念以及为了探索自身生存方式而毅然踏上旅途的决心都被刻画得活灵活现。在本篇剧情里没能得到充分展现的角色魅力终于迎来了彻底绽放，绝对是一个会让人铭记于心的优秀故事。
两个不吐不快的槽点
虽然达米安和翁卡的故事编写得相当出色，但最核心的克里夫篇的剧情表现却令人感到有些失望。虽然踏上一段新旅途的故事本身没有太大问题，但中途莫名其妙地插入了一段在沙尘暴中靠着难以看清的路标指引四处奔走的跑腿任务。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/0bdc772ee615fda386c5b6aad268c2c6/
在这种能见度几乎为零的恶劣环境中被迫步行探索的体验实在太费神费力了，导致把故事原本营造的感动氛围全都一步步消磨殆尽。如果能把路标提示设计得更显眼一些，或者适当减少跑腿的次数可能会好上不少。话虽如此，3 名主角中有 2 位的故事都还是很不错的，因此我依然对未来可能会推出的剧情 DLC 抱有极高的期待。
至于 DLC 的第三个卖点，那就是玩家可以与其他的普通的 NPC 或者设计有专属任务的 4 位魔女结婚了。能在俊男靓女云集的世界中和心仪的角色结成伴侣当然是很令人开心的一件事。
但不得不提的是，一旦 NPC 被迎娶回家，就会变成一个智慧杵在原地或者整天睡觉的“家里蹲”（并且除了 4 位魔女之外，其他 NPC 甚至没有任何的专属对话）。
更致命的是，如果结婚的对象原本是个商人，那么在结婚之后他/她就会立刻丧失商人的功能，反而让游戏的体验变得更加不便。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/bd303df8661e7c015a735dc601846d3e/
能和心爱之人同居当然很令人开心，但商店直接停止营业是绝对不能接受的。特别是如果选择和魔女成为伴侣，将不得不承担极高的负面代价。虽然已经有玩家通过自制 MOD 改善 PC 版的体验，但我还是强烈希望官方能尽快推出更新修复这一问题。（考虑到官方此前的更新频率，应该要不了多久就能解决吧）
总评：原作粉丝绝对不容错过的大型 DLC
《红色沙漠》本体那种“地图规模太大导致探索需要耗费大量时间”的特点依然在这次的 DLC 里得到了继承。因此，如果你之前就已经对本体的庞大内容量感到有点疲惫的话，老实说我并不推荐直接游玩本作。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/c5eb410f42d89ddf010c8249384d27a9/
反之，如果你很享受本体的探索体验，那这部 DLC 绝对是不容错过的。规模扩大 4 倍左右的海洋与海底探索场景、扎实厚重的后日谈故事以及庭院试炼等强力 Boss 再战玩法的加入都为 DLC 塞入了远超其定价的充实内容。
如果想着“找个周末直接通关吧”，那是绝对不可能的。这部 DLC 简直就像是一个无底洞，要是你当前的游戏时间并不充裕，理智一点等以后打折再购入也不失为一种明智的选择。面对着这片每天都有新发现的汪洋大海，笔者今天也会继续压榨自己的睡眠时间，选择扬帆出海。
原作者：いーさん 翻译：Bluestoon 编辑：熊猫命

news.title: RPGmaker创作大赛最佳游戏《倘若你想见到明天》试玩版上线

content.v: 你能在60分钟内活下来吗？RPGmaker创作大赛最佳游戏《倘若你想见到明天》试玩版上线
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1113/20261113142303-7689-16704.png?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
11月13日，由独立游戏开发团队刺球装置（Oddball Gizmo）开发、月尾尾游戏（Tailtone Games）发行的暗黑叙事多分支RPG游戏《倘若你想见到明天》正式公开免费试玩版。本作曾在 RPG MAKER创作大赛中荣获最佳游戏奖。玩家将亲自进入这场60分钟的荒诞人类价值评判实验，经历象征优秀人类的重重试炼。 游戏介绍
《倘若你想见到明天》是一款以暗黑叙事、怪诞剧情体验为核心的多分支叙事 RPG，通过限时的生存实验，以及对人类的价值评判，隐喻荒诞的现实社会规训。包含地图探索、解谜及多周目玩法。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1113/20261113142303-8700-95746.png?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
地图探索与解谜
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1113/20261113142303-5988-38129.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
游戏设置了分别对应外貌、财富和力量的三个实验场。玩家需要逐步解锁不同房间，在探索过程中寻找提升积分的机会，同时发现隐藏在实验场中的线索。
部分特殊房间还将引导玩家进入对应的主线剧情，解锁更多关于实验场与角色的秘密。

news.title: 《龙珠大魔》删掉波波，观众只闻其声不见其人
news.summary: 他说话，但不出现在画面上！！太丢人了。

content.v: 法国Gulli少儿频道播出《龙珠大魔》，贡献了最灵异的动画场面。观众看到悟空对着空气一本正经地说话，而波波先生直接 “肉身蒸发”，观众只闻其声，但画面里说话的人彻底消失无踪。
别家动画的河蟹，是不断给角色加布料，怎么到《龙珠》这，直接就将波波先生给“画面除名”了?
2026年11月4日，法国Gulli频道首播《龙珠大魔》，它是《龙珠》40周年纪念新作，也是鸟山明生前亲自参与剧情与角色设计的龙珠动画。故事时间线放在布欧篇之后，悟空、贝吉塔、比克一行人遭魔界反派戈麻的阴谋，被神龙的力量变回孩童模样。为恢复原本身形、营救丹迪，众人踏上前往魔界的全新 冒险 。
可动画才刚播出第一集，观众很快就发现里面不对劲。
动画里本该是波波先生出场的镜头，遭到裁切和放大镜头，把波波挤出画框直接消失，连回忆画面里的短暂出场也没放过。更诡异的是，波波先生画面虽然没了，但台词一句没动。观众能清清楚楚听到波波在说话，但屏幕上就是找不到人。
这个电视版本与“在日本播出的版本”不同，同样这一集，其他法语区流媒体版本、日版、港版，波波画面完整。偏偏对波波的改动，就只局限在欧洲少儿电视频道的播出版。
这一“有声无影”的处理，迅速在社交平台引发讨论。法国粉丝直接在社媒上开骂：他说话，但不出现在画面上！！太丢人了。
波波先生的角色形象在欧美市场一直是饱受争议。
无独有偶，2010年美版《龙珠改》在CW4Kids播出时，就直接把波波的皮肤刷成了蓝色，嘴唇也顺手收敛了一下。到2.0版本后更省事，从改色转向物理 隔离 ，靠裁切让波波干脆不出现在镜头里。
龙珠一众配角里，虽然存在不同版本被阉割或是被河蟹的角色处理，但几乎没有角色像波波这样，二十多年来持续遭遇这种 “定点处理”。每当有新作上线、平台重新引进龙珠系列，他的形象都要单独拿出来重新评估一遍，随时面临画面裁切、修改甚至抹除。
之所以波波遭到连环修改，全在于波波先生这个经典角色的外形争议上。
波波先生早在初代《龙珠》就登场，是驻守天神殿的古老守护者，并非人类，属于龙珠世界独有的奇幻生命体。他负责照料神殿、修复龙珠，还曾经亲自训练过小悟空，是龙珠世界观里资历极深的元老配角。
鸟山明当年设计这个角色时，本意只是塑造一个神秘沉稳的神殿管家，可这套造型放到欧美文化语境里，纯黑皮肤、白眼球、夸张厚红唇的视觉特征，让这个形象自带极高的舆论风险，尤其是放到欧美文化语境中，极易和黑脸表演的历史符号产生联想。
仅管角色并没有这层涵义，但仍会因外部形象遭到刻意曲解，不止《龙珠》，甚至就连《小羊肖恩》也没有被放过。
就在不久前的万圣节，日本声优反田叶月当年为还原《小羊肖恩》，直接涂黑整张脸来匹配小羊黑色面部，再裹上棉花 模拟 羊毛。在粉丝看来，这只是一次用心的角色复刻，有趣又贴合原作。
可图片传到海外平台之后，争议瞬间发酵。部分欧美网友认为，将脸部涂黑的装扮，刚好撞上西方历史臭名昭著的黑脸表演;再加上搭配的道具，进一步触发了关于敏感话题的刻板印象联想。
这种对特殊符号“敏感”的来源，并非空穴来风。
金发蓝眼的超级赛亚人形象，在欧美被指控为白人至上”的视觉宣传，只因为金发蓝眼与超人力量的绑定“暗示了某种种族等级”。
2026年，美国官方社交媒体多次未经授权使用《龙珠》、《火影忍者》、《宝可梦》等经典动漫形象进行政治宣传，即使官方多次与向美方提出交涉，要求妥善处理，都遭到美方拒绝。霓虹民众发起联署抗议，主张这些作品“长期传递友情、勇气和共同体价值，却被置于战争和驱逐移民的宣传场景中”。
于是，为了避免这些无端指控，不少海外播出平台选择提前进行自我审查，甚至会根据不同地域当下的舆论风向决定。
但话又说回来了，如果只做外貌解读方式，相当于剥离了角色完整世界观，只拎出单一视觉特征做审判。
无视角色所处的奇幻世界观、人物背景和创作者的原始构思，单独截取一张外貌、一个画面符号，套入现实社会的政治与种族叙事之中。波波并非人类，只是龙珠世界里守护神殿的古老生灵;小羊肖恩也仅仅是动画里的一只绵羊。但在这套评判逻辑下，这些前提都被直接忽略。
文艺作品可以承载创作者的观点，但观众的评判也需要建立在完整故事语境之上，而不是断章取义地提取视觉符号，用现实世界的历史框架去硬套幻想生物。
无论是天神殿的波波，还是卡通小羊肖恩，创作者的出发点都很简单，只是塑造一个虚构形象。这种从三次元延伸至跨次元的审判，将现实里的矛盾，搬运到二次元的幻想空间，再投射到动画角色的虚构载体上，把原本纯粹的艺术形象，强行绑定上本不存在的敏感议题。创作者并没有输出偏见的主观想法，角色本身也不承载任何现实立场，可仅仅因为外形上的巧合，就要承担现实层面的指责。
如果单一外观就能成为审判标准，那么创作的题材和角色就会处处受限。创作者在设计形象时，不再优先考虑故事与想象力，而是不停自查外形，规避所有可能产生联想的视觉特征，幻想创作的空间会持续收窄。当文艺作品总要为某些符号联想做出妥协，那么以后留给观众理解的余地，也就越来越少。

news.title: 你的选择会改变漫画——本格推理《久世透事件帖》Steam 页面上线

content.v: https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1113/20261113120030-9305-66551.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
Nightpage Studio 开发、Vplus 发行的本格推理冒险游戏《久世透 事件帖 ―说谎者消失于雨中―》（英文名：Kuze Tooru Case Files: The Liar Vanishes in the Rain）现已开放 Steam 商店页面，预计 2026 年冬季发售，支持简体中文。欢迎加入愿望单。
如果你也曾追着《金田一少年之事件簿》，在翻开解答篇之前拼命想自己揪出凶手——这就是为你做的本格推理游戏。
Steam 商店页面： Steam 上的 Kuze Tooru Case Files: The Liar Vanishes in the Rain
■ 故事 雨夜里，谎言还没有结束。 便利店里的一场小风波，让善于观察的私家侦探久世透，遇上了最讨厌先入为主的警视厅刑警鸣海玲。 不久，一对姐妹找上久世：请帮我们找到妹妹。 母亲十七回忌那天，久世一行来到海边的老宅「潮鸣馆」—— 从十六年前的同一天延续至今的谎言，究竟藏着什么？
■ 游戏特色
◆ 你的选择，会改变漫画 你在每一章做出的选择，都会改变这一章漫画版的内容。解谜的方式、指认的对象不同，画进漫画里的情节也会不同。 在〈立绘ADV〉中查案：调查现场、询问证人、解开谜题、指认凶手。每破完一章，就会解锁这一章的〈漫画篇〉，以昭和推理漫画的画风重现你亲手破解的过程。
◆ 以昭和漫画技法，一格一格重现 网点纸、交叉排线、大面积涂黑、集中线、G 笔线条。 献给走过昭和与平成、曾为推理漫画着迷的每一位推理迷。
◆ 本格推理——所有线索都摆在你眼前 就像《金田一少年之事件簿》那样，解开真相所需的线索，在解答篇之前都已经交给了你。 用放大镜调查现场，找出证词里的矛盾，把手帐里的证据串起来。 解答篇之前，还有让你亲手指认凶手的〈读者挑战〉。
◆ 用你自己的话，逼问真相 面对嫌疑人和证人，可以直接用中文或日语自由提问，也可以把证据照片摆到对方面前。 理解你提问的是游戏内置的本地 AI：无需联网，也不额外收费。
◆ 解谜，从简单的题目开始 电车换乘路线、三根保险丝、被折起的雨伞…… 每章都穿插轻松好玩的小谜题，第一次玩推理游戏也能放心上手。 每一章都收录 4 道轻松的小谜题和 1～2 道本格推理题，全篇共 80 道以上。
◆ 系列第一案 「久世透 事件帖」系列的第一个案件。 久世透的招牌台词只有一句—— "我是久世透。凶手就在这里，让我来告诉你真相！"

content.v: 20 余名 id Software 被裁员工成立了由员工持股的新工作室 Hidden Horses，并在 Kickstarter 上为首部作品《Danger Pay》开启了众筹。
工作室成员表示，采用员工持股的架构可以让他们“把长期健康放在短期增长之前、把长远的存续放在季度回报之前、把创新玩法放在不光彩的变现手段之前”。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/439860fc4d29b28e9e1899f650b192f4/
《Danger Pay》是一款快节奏单机 FPS，围绕一场致命的综艺节目展开，以施瓦辛格主演的 1987 版《过关斩将》和经典街机游戏《电视斗士》（Smash TV）为灵感，节目由一个邪恶而致命的 AI 主持。

news.title: 影之刃零曾说首发不做Boss连战！玩家请愿 会有吗？
news.summary: 最近一段时间，《影之刃零》玩家们陆续通关游戏，也有很多人开启了自己的二周目复仇之旅，与此同时，也有很多玩家不愿意重玩一遍复…

content.v: 最近一段时间，《影之刃零》玩家们陆续通关游戏，也有很多人开启了自己的二周目复仇之旅，与此同时，也有很多玩家不愿意重玩一遍复杂的流程， 更希望 灵游坊能推出“Boss连战”模式来方便玩家重新挑战已战胜的Boss。
而值得一提的是，其实早在游戏发售前的 一次采访 中，游戏制作人“Soulframe”就曾谈及过这个话题，并表示首发版本暂时没有这个计划。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/13/small_202611131031103914.jpg
他表示：“目前首发版本没有安排Boss连战玩法，主要出于制作与玩法设计两方面的考量。”
“首先是制作层面。本作的大型Boss战和剧情演出、过场动画耦合性太高，战斗都发生在特定的场景，战斗与叙事环节穿插进行，来营造一个完整的战斗体验，很难单独拆出来做成连战关卡。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/13/small_202611131031157354.jpg
“其次从玩法设计来讲，我们更希望玩家通过多周目、‘六十六天’模式来反复挑战、体验全部Boss内容，这也是我们现阶段的核心游玩设计。”
不过，他并没有完全扼杀推出“Boss连战”模式的可能性，梁其伟补充表示：“当然，等多数玩家通关、熟悉游戏内容之后，未来我们也有可能开发一些新模式，比如更轻量化、纯战斗向的挑战模式，作为后续内容迭代的补充，都是有可能的。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/13/small_202611131031214849.jpg
所以目前来看，能否推出Boss连战还是一个未知数，还要看灵游坊实际的工作进度和安排，在官方确认之前，我们也只能暂时保持期待。

content.v: https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/headpic/2026/11/8bb1f9864ca2f6b24cb49920502610f2.jpg

2026 CiGADC开发者大会完整日程现已公开！今年CiGA邀请来自全球各地的嘉宾，每一位嘉宾都是行业各领域的杰出代表，分享涉及包括《边狱巴士》、《杀戮尖塔》、《吸血鬼幸存者》、《孤山独影》、《梦之形》、《心跳文学部！》、《龙胤立志传》、《幻兽帕鲁》等作品。通过行业杰出代表的亲身经历分享，从游戏开发、发行等多个领域，带给与会者宝贵的经验与财富。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/docx/2026/11/fb8d804ad7167.jpg
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/docx/2026/11/fb8d804ad7168.jpg
从《归家异途》到《龙胤立志传》，夫妻二人组建的工作室10年时间打造了3款销量与口碑都双丰收的游戏，在2026 CiGADC开发大会上，TppStudio策划&程序朱晨将围绕《归家异途1&2》《龙胤立志传》三款作品，剖析创作初衷、开发经历、成功经验与失败教训，分享并探讨团队十年以来制作独立游戏的心得体会和经验教训。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/docx/2026/11/fb8d804ad7169.jpg
《孤山独影》的成功除了沉浸式的攀爬玩法，也离不开营销活动。来自法国的独立游戏工作室The Game Bakers拥有自己的发行团队，完全依靠自有资金并自行发行作品，始终保持独立运营。在本次演讲中，Lauranne Cauduro将对《孤山独影》营销活动的复盘，以及其沉浸式、直观的攀爬玩法对游戏成功的重要作用。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/docx/2026/11/fb8d804ad71610.jpg
创始人兼 CEO 杨正华（Z）将分享个人经历如何影响他创立公司的初衷，以及 Serenity Forge 如何把“创造有意义、能引发思考的体验”落实到游戏开发与发行中。通过《心跳文学部！》和《绯花绽放》等作品，他将探讨游戏如何借助情感与叙事触动玩家，以及团队如何在不断变化的行业和全球市场中坚守创作方向、持续调整做法。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/docx/2026/11/fb8d804ad71611.jpg
平台给了所有人上架的权利，却没有给任何人读懂海外玩家的能力。Steam is not a strategy。（Steam不是发行战略。）如何把中国开发者的产品逻辑，翻译成西方玩家能够进入的社群语言和消费语境，来听Goldpact Goblins CEO Vladislav Tsopljak带来的分享。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/docx/2026/11/fb8d804ad71612.jpg
2025年9月上线的韩国独立游戏《梦之形》无疑是2025年年度独立游戏的代表之一。《梦之形》在发售后一年，用四次大版本的更新对游戏不断进行迭代。从《梦之形》最初的项目立项，到1周年的更新，Lizard Smoothie的CEO沈恩燮有许多思考与总结，本大大会上讲带来《梦之形——我们本可以做的更好的地方》的主题分享。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/docx/2026/11/fb8d804ad71613.jpg
Mega Crit Games 联合创始人 Casey Yano与IGN Japan 主编 Daniel Robson 展开现场对谈。两位将围绕《杀戮尖塔》系列近十年的开发历程，从游戏设计与独立开发的角度，深入交流经典玩法的诞生、核心机制的打磨、续作开发中的传承与创新，以及独立团队在长期创作过程中积累的经验与思考。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/docx/2026/11/fb8d804ad71614.jpg
《保持独立，迎接复杂挑战：poncle 的成长与蜕变》——保持独立游戏定位，并不意味着一切都能保持简单；相反，独立意味着工作室仍需自主判断，同时承担更多责任、协调更多资源。成长不是简单地变大，而是在复杂中重新定义独立：既要建立必要的流程与协作机制，又要守住独立游戏工作室最初的创造力、灵活性与不拘一格的精神。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/docx/2026/11/fb8d804ad7162.jpg
一款上线两年多的游戏，如何再次吸引玩家的目光？Bucky因在《幻兽帕鲁》和《创世理想乡》中的工作而为玩家熟知，如今已成为 Pocketpair 备受关注的对外代表人物。在本次大会上，Bucky将来到现场，带来题为“《幻兽帕鲁》1.0 — 再掀热潮”的演讲，分享此次版本上线背后的发行与传播经验。
https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/docx/2026/11/fb8d804ad7163.jpg
从《脑叶公司》的封闭公司到《废墟图书馆》的城市舞台，再到《边狱巴士》的公路之旅，月亮计划用十年时间搭建了一个完整而连贯的叙事宇宙。月亮计划的成功离不开金智勋对于独特世界观叙事的追求，他从文学、神话与哲学中汲取创作灵感，打造黑暗与反乌托邦的世界观。
